summary: Anything with wheels that a character can ride or that can crash.
status: written and tested on moon_buggy_a only

required_in_behavior_file.parts: at least 2 wheels (kind: spin, with radius_m); doors (kind: hinge) are optional
required_in_behavior_file.crash: min_speed_mps, crumple, recoil_m, open_parts (which parts pop open)

rules_the_engine_applies_automatically: wheels turn by ground distance / radius_m, so rolling matches the speed; they lock at a crash
a door opens when a character comes within within_m and the vehicle is (almost) still, and closes when it drives
a crash happens when the vehicle moves at or above min_speed_mps and its ground circle touches a solid object (scene object with solid_radius_m)
after a crash the vehicle stops dead, rebounds a little, squashes, and shows stars, dust and a camera kick
a rider is thrown forward, throws his arms up and looks shocked after a crash
a rider gets out beside the vehicle, on the door side if it has a door
the camera can frame the vehicle and its rider automatically (camera key with a frame block)
not_done_yet: steering (front wheels turning when the vehicle turns)
clean doors and wheels: parts are cut out of one solid model, so edges are rough; generate vehicles with separate parts instead
real bending metal; the crash is a squash plus effects
how_numbers_are_chosen: today: written by hand from general knowledge. Later: an AI fills in size, speed and weight (with a source link for real-world vehicles) and the checks in motion_studio/library.py validate the file.
